name: Just Tell Him!
source:
Cooper has liked Beacon ever since high school- so, when Beacon gives him his number and asks him out on a date he realizes there's still something important to talk about before they're fully together.

Cooper is asexual and he doesn't know if Beacon will be okay with that.


Despite his anxiety, Cooper knows he really needs to tell him.


[From [url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/just-tell-him]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
库珀从高中起就喜欢比肯——所以，当比肯给了他电话号码并约他出去时，他意识到在他们完全在一起之前还有一些重要的事情要谈。

库珀是无性恋者，他不知道比肯是否同意这一点。


尽管很焦虑，库珀知道他确实需要告诉他。


[来自[url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/just-tell-him]itch.io[/url]]
